title: (‡): μ has approximate tangent plane (span{ν_E(x)})^⊥ with multiplicity 1 at every reduced-boundary point
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, E ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable and (μ, ν) a Gauss-Green pair for (U, E) (IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν). Let x ∈ ∂*E := reducedBoundary U μ ν and P := (span{ν_E(x)})^⊥ with ν_E(x) := reducedNormal μ ν x. Then HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1: finrank P = n and for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), (rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y) → 1·∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n], η_{x,r} = blowUpMap x r).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x ((Submodule.span ℝ {reducedNormal μ ν x})ᗮ) 1
